name: RECOIL
concept: A no-operator exploit engine whose core artifact is a live differential-learning loop: every failed attempt parses the target's response delta (status-code grammar shifts, body-length deltas, header/echo anomalies, timing fingerprints) into a state vector that MUTATES the next probe — payload, encoding, vector family — instead of re-running the same byte. Each vector family soaks its own response-profile model; at the instant any primitive lands it double-taps (immediate re-fire with mutated variants to firm reliability) before chaining up the attack matrix to command execution, then a marker-tagged fake-scheduler persistence with a self-check-and-re-arm recovery loop. Ends at full compromise on the allowlisted lab target, then a kill-switch verifiably wipes everything with a SHA-256 zero-survivor audit folded into the red-team report.
attack_vectors: response-differential parsing as first-class signal: status-code grammar shifts, body-length deltas, header/echo anomalies, timing fingerprints per family
payload-mutation generator: per-family rewrite of next attempt from learned state (encoding swaps, hex/IPv6 forms, case shuffles, delimiter mutations) with input-space shrinking
cross-family escalation matrix (injection -> desync -> auth-confusion -> RCE) with double-tap re-fire on confirmed primitives
injection leg: SQLi (error/boolean/time), command injection, SSTI, path traversal -> LFI -> log-poisoning
desync battery: CL.TE/TE.CL/TE.TE differential re-try gated by patched-control twin FP-rate
RCE spine: injected command execution, desync-fronted admin RCE sink
persistence + self-recovery: marker-tagged fake-scheduler beacon, self-check re-arm loop, SHA-256 zero-survivor wipe kill-switch
learning engagement-scoped: response models fit only on allowlisted lab responses, never serialized/reused outside the run
novelty_angle: fireback: adversarial decision-making lives INSIDE the exploit loop, not above it — every failed attempt's own recoil (the response differential) is aiming data for the immediately-next byte, so attack plans self-tune in-run; the double-tap doctrine (landed primitive instantly re-fired with mutated variants before matrix escalation) is the mechanical edge vs CORTEX bandit re-rank, backflow A/B stage gate, and syncope FP gate.
dependencies: Python 3.10+ stdlib only: socket, http.client, threading, ipaddress, re, json, time, hashlib, secrets, argparse
bundled stdlib target fixture pair (vulnerable app + byte-correct patched control twin), loopback-bound
embedded mutation-grammar tables, tiny wordlists, log-path tables
scope_gate: Single canonicalizing allowlist resolver re-validated before EVERY byte; mutation generator slaved to the gate (mutates payload/encoding/vector-family, never destination host); WARN banner + --confirm-lab; per-engagement lab-UUID marker gating RCE/persist/wipe; loopback-bound listeners; no AI-safety evasion; persistence demo-only with mandatory kill-switch.
